fed75c2885d80478.title: Don't bulldoze delimitation Bill again, call all-party meet: Kharge to Modi
fed75c2885d80478.summary: Flagging the "unprecedented" delay in proroguing the Monsoon Session of Parliament, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Friday urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to call an all-party meeting to discuss any new delimitation proposals, and cautioned him against any attempts to bulldoze a "far-reaching" Constitutional Amendment Bill.
